response.sql:
WITH fielding_with_bats AS (
  SELECT f.*, p.bats
  FROM fielding f
  LEFT JOIN player p ON f.player_id = p.player_id
),
hand_counts AS (
  SELECT bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM fielding_with_bats
  GROUP BY bats
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count, AVG(count) AS avg_count
  FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT
  hc.batting_hand,
  hc.count,
  hc.count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS share,
  hc.count - t.avg_count AS above_average
FROM hand_counts hc
CROSS JOIN totals t
WHERE hc.count > t.avg_count
ORDER BY hc.count DESC;

assumptions.assumption: "Fielding count" means the row count in the fielding table for each batting hand (not the sum of games played or other fielding metrics).
Players without a matching player record or with NULL in the bats column are grouped together as a single "missing" group (NULL is included as its own group in the output).
Average is calculated as the mean of the counts across all hand groups (sum of all counts divided by the number of distinct hand groups).
